git_status_worktree: check the git status of your worktree to see modified, staged, and untracked files
git_add_commit: stage files with git_add then commit staged changes with git_commit using a descriptive message
git_rebase_resolve_conflicts: rebase your branch onto main and resolve conflicts by editing files then calling git_rebase_continue
git_merge_branch: merge a feature branch into main with git_merge using --no-ff to preserve the merge commit
git_diff_review_changes: show uncommitted changes with git_diff or compare two branches with git_diff_branches for PR review
